owner: AppStore/film (Claude session). The website session reads this folder and doesn't edit it.

video.loop: seamless: starts and ends on the same still spread (one page turn forward, one back)
video.attributes: autoplay muted loop playsinline, with poster

demo.background: #F5F0E6, baked into the video; match the slide behind it or put it in a #F5F0E6 frame
demo.device: Apple's iPhone Duo model (V68.usdz from Xcode 27.1), rendered open and flat, 1180 px wide at its true 164.6 × 117.8 mm proportions, with the screen flush in the body
demo.screen: Genuine simctl recording of the inner display (2852 × 2006): Honbako's native page curl, right to left, in the Honbako Capture duo simulator with --honbako-licensed-marketing-sample
demo.content: Original Honbako sample story 星を待つ駅 / After The Last Train, character art by Wataobi (pages 1–4). No Black Jack, no personal library, no account.

film_current.muted: #45423B (deliberately darker than the site's #78746B, for 17 px mono footnotes)
film_current.seal: #C23B22, only the small secondary 本箱 seal on the title page
film_current.note: Aligned with the app on 2026-10-31. Details and remaining conflicts: film-brand-aligned.json.

type.headlines: Baskerville (macOS), regular; italic for secondary lines
type.labels: Courier New Bold, uppercase, tracked about 0.15em, for small feature labels
type.japanese: Hiragino Mincho ProN W6 for 本箱
type.web_note: Baskerville and Hiragino Mincho ship only on Apple platforms. For the web, a fallback stack such as Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', Georgia, serif keeps the look; check the licence of any webfont before you add it.

logo: Use the canonical app icon AppStore/assets/AppIcon-1024.png as the lead mark. The film now uses it on its title page and end card. The film's small drawn 本箱 seal is a secondary editorial mark, not a logo.
copy_rules: Plain feature copy. No 'first' or 'world's first'.
AI-provider account is separate from Honbako; requests sync while Honbako is open.
Tag Pro features: Japanese reading help, Duo cover display, Remote MCP server, downloads and alerts, reading-time and update widgets.
Honbako doesn't provide manga; sources and their content are the user's responsibility.
Provider names or icons may appear where relevant, with no affiliation claim.
film_alignment: See film-brand-aligned.json for what changed, render status and the conflicts that remain.
